## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) RECOVERY (↑ rising) and SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION confirm short-term volatility with no clear directional follow-through.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit tightening pressure: HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling) and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling). Commodity-driven volatility is elevating risk dispersion: BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND is a dominant mover.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND indicates higher yields pressure (↓ falling) while SPY/TLT reads as mixed; dollar and yield-curve signals remain broadly flat in the tape.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY while XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION — style mixed, no clean growth leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US soft in the week: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION; China showing month resilience: FXI (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) CORRECTION; EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY — global performance uneven.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed risk appetite: IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto demand while ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND signals reduced thematic risk-taking; MTUM (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -4.79%) RECOVERY highlights short-term rotation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity reflation leadership: USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclical pressure; CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND supports industrial tone.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy firmly strong: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND and BNO ABOVE TREND — monitor spillover into inflation and real yields; UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND shows clear dual-timeframe strength. DIVERGENCE: multiple ETFs in CORRECTION (XLF, FXI, ETHA, etc.) and core mismatches (SPY CORRECTION vs TLT BELOW TREND) signal a transitional market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy cyclicals and commodity plays like XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to longer-duration and growth-sensitive ETFs such as QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND while monitoring TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials — sector breadth showing strength (Industrials 1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%). BEARISH: Technology — QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary (1W: -4.53% | 1M: -2.82%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/Watch: Natural gas UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY — high volatility risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency/alert threshold); HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 (credit-health pivot); XLK/XLF cross ~2.0 (growth vs value rotation pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) and commodity-linked ETFs (USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) / BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%)) are showing strength. Key risk: broad 1W/1M divergences (multiple CORRECTIONs including SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION) — monitor for a decisive directional shift.
